استدعين (form X)
# اِسْتَدْعَيْنَ (istadʕayna) /is.tad.ʕaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
# اُسْتُدْعِينَ (ustudʕīna) /us.tud.ʕiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
# اِسْتَدْعِينَ (istadʕīna) /is.tad.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَدْعَى (istadʕā)
